SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.BRANCH, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finProductCode, NVL(A.FINPROD_NAME,A.PINAN_ASSET_TYPE) finprodAbbr, A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO customAssetTypeTwo, A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE customAssetTypeThree, A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR customAssetTypeFour, A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE customAssetTypeFive, A.CRN crn, A.ASSET_RISK_TYPE assetRiskType, R1.pinanAssetType FROM ASSET_TARGET_DB A JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID=B.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID AND C.FINPROD_TYPE2='F16' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.OUTPUT_VALUE_4 AS pinanAssetType, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG T2 ON T1.TYPE_8=T2.INPUT_VALUE_1 AND T1.TYPE_9=T2.INPUT_VALUE_2 AND T1.TYPE_10=T2.INPUT_VALUE_3 AND T1.TYPE_11=T2.INPUT_VALUE_4 AND T1.TYPE_12=T2.INPUT_VALUE_5 AND T2.config_type= 'PED_RISK_TYPE' ) R1 ON R1.finprodId=A.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1 /*不存在正回购和拆借资产交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ASSET_TARGET_DB AA WHERE ((AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO='12' and AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE='45' AND ((AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR='091'AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE='093' ) or (AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR='092' AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE='094'))) OR (AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO='12' and AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE='45' AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR='093'AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE='095') OR (AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO='06' and AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE='22' AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR='094'AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE='096') OR (AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO='12'AND AA.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE='46') ) AND AA.FINPROD_ID=A.FINPROD_ID )
AND A.IS_PERNE='01'
AND A.IS_PERNE='03'
AND A.CDATE=TRUNC(TO_DATE(substr(#{generateTime},1,10),'yyyy-MM-dd')-1) AND C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{finProductCode} AND A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO IS NOT NULL AND A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE IS NOT NULL AND A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR IS NOT NULL AND A.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRD_RISK_LEVEL (SEQ_NO, BRANCH, IS_LAST, GENERATE_TIME, FIN_PRODUCT_CODE, RISK_LEVEL, AJUST_RISK_LEVEL, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{seqNo}, 0, 'Y', #{generateTime}, #{finProductCode}, #{riskLevel}, #{ajustRiskLevel}, #{createUser}, #{createDept}, SYSDATE, #{updateUser}, SYSDATE )

insert into PRD_ASSET_RISK_LEVEL (RISK_LEVEL_NO, SEQ_NO, ASSET_BRANCH, CDATE, ASSET_TYPE, RISK_LEVEL, AJUST_RISK_LEVEL, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{riskLevelNo}, #{seqNo}, 0, #{generateTime}, #{finProductCode}, #{riskLevel}, #{ajustRiskLevel}, #{createUser}, #{createDept}, SYSDATE, #{updateUser}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT (*) COT FROM PRD_RISK_LEVEL WHERE FIN_PRODUCT_CODE= #{finProductCode} AND substr(GENERATE_TIME,1,10)=substr(#{generateTime},1,10)
SELECT ASSET_TYPE finProductCode, AJUST_RISK_LEVEL ajustRiskLevel FROM PRD_ASSET_RISK_LEVEL WHERE SEQ_NO=#{seqNo}
